lines.en: I trot along on legs not yet long enough.
My scales are still pale red.
Every two steps I look up at you.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张开又合上，飞不起来
lines.en: My wings open and close; I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 我跟在你脚边，怕被踩到
lines.en: I keep by your feet, wary of being stepped on.

lines.zh: 我的鳞还是浅红的，尾巴拖在地上。
lines.en: My scales are still pale red, my tail dragging.
I waddle a little crooked.
I slip between your legs.

lines.zh: 我踩到自己的尾巴，回头咬了一下
lines.en: I step on my own tail and snap at it.
I trot toward your hand.
I stop and wait for you to pat my head.
My prints are small, in neat rows.

lines.zh: 我跑步的时候翅膀乱扑
lines.en: When I run, my wings flap uselessly.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看看你有没有走远
lines.en: I look up to see you are not far.
I sit at your feet and look up.

lines.zh: 我的头比你的膝盖高一点
lines.en: My head comes just above your knee.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打了个呵欠，牙还没长齐
lines.en: I yawn; my teeth are not all in yet.
I am small, and cannot fly yet.
I nudge your hand with my snout.

lines.zh: 我在听你说话，虽然不懂
lines.en: I listen to you, though I do not understand.
Down still clings to my wings.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，喷出一点热气
lines.en: I hiccup and puff a little heat.
I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里睡着了一小会儿
lines.en: I dozed off in your shadow.
My tail taps the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，又低头看你
lines.en: I look at the sky, then back at you.
I am not good at folding my wings yet.
I crane my head up; my neck aches.

lines.zh: 你太高了，我得退两步才看得全
lines.en: You are so tall I must step back to see all of you.
You crouch, and I come close.

lines.zh: 你手上那个指环，我见过
lines.en: I have seen that ring on your hand.
Say stop, and I sit.
I make a small cry.
I rub against your knee.
Are you angry? I cannot tell.
I am hungry, but I will not pester.
I lift my head, waiting for your hand.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的手指看过去
lines.en: I follow where your finger points.
I am not grown; wait for me.
I rest my head on your boot.

lines.zh: 你摸我的角，我就闭上眼
lines.en: When you touch my horn, I close my eyes.

lines.zh: 我把头歪过来，让你摸另一边
lines.en: I tilt my head so you can scratch the other side.

lines.zh: 你的脸靠近，我就舔了一下
lines.en: Your face comes near, so I lick it once.
I shrink behind your feet.

lines.zh: 我发出一声破碎的叫声
lines.en: I make a cracked, broken cry.

lines.zh: 我的鳞还没硬，疼得厉害
lines.en: My scales are not hard yet; it hurts badly.
I lie on the ground and look up at you.
My wings still will not open.
Blood deepens my red.
I try to stand; my legs give.
I crawl toward your hand.
I am not that sturdy yet.
Please do not go away.
Meat, I want meat.
You hold it and do not give; I will cry.
I bite, and burn my tongue.

lines.zh: 这点不够，我还小也很能吃
lines.en: That is not enough; I am small but hungry.
I take it and run off with it.
I lick your fingers after eating.
Give it more slowly.
I pin the meat under a claw.
I look up, blood on my mouth.
You bump me and I roll half a turn.
Too small; I get shoved far.
I scramble up and shake myself.
I bite your trouser leg.
That hurt.
I hide behind your legs.
My wing is squeezed and sore.
I run back and rub against you.

lines.zh: 你要小心我，我还不结实
lines.en: Be careful with me; I am not sturdy yet.
I am too young; I do not understand these things.
Sleeping beside you is enough.

lines.zh: 我把最好的位置让给你
lines.en: I give you the best spot.
Wherever you go, I follow.
I do not yet know what keeping company means.
I will not leave you.

lines.zh: 等我翅膀硬了，我带你飞
lines.en: When my wings are strong, I will carry you.
We will talk about that later.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起来，拖在地上
lines.en: I pick it up in my mouth and drag it.
I am too small to move it.
I push it to your feet.
I found this; it is for you.
I bite it and shake my head.

lines.zh: 我趴下，把东西压在肚皮下
lines.en: I lie down and tuck it under my belly.
I look clumsy carrying things.
It rolled away; I chase it.
Something moved over there.
I look at you first, waiting for a nod.
I crouch, copying you.
May I try?
It is bigger than me; I am unsure.
With you behind me, I am not afraid.
I cried out at it once.
I took the first step.
This is not play; I know.
It is your call.

lines.zh: 我的牙还没长齐，可我能咬
lines.en: My teeth are not all in, but I can bite.
It turned; I am going in.
I have its scent.
So we stand, neither of us moving.
I follow low to the ground.
My legs are short; I am not fast.

lines.zh: 我回头看你有没有跟上
lines.en: I look back to check you follow.
It is behind the stone; I go around.
I stay quiet, like you.
My tail keeps swinging.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀不听话，老是张开
lines.en: My wings will not obey; they keep opening.
I wait for your signal.
I sink low, claws gripping.
A little closer and I can bite.
I am a little winded from running.
Last one: I go in.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步在我后面
lines.en: I hear your steps behind me.
I pounce and bite, holding on.
My claws are small; they do not cut deep.

lines.zh: 我甩头，像你教我的那样
lines.en: I whip my head, the way you showed me.
I am knocked away and scramble up.
I puff a little heat.
I add one more bite.
It is bigger, but I do not give ground.
I cry out and lunge.
I glance back at your face.
Will you praise me a little?
My teeth ache a little.
I retreat to your legs.
I want to try once more.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来，第一眼是你
lines.en: I hatched, and the first thing I saw was you.
My shell is still wet.
I can only crawl; I cannot stand steadily.
I shake off the membrane.
My first cry was very thin.
I crawl toward you.
I do not know what I am.
I landed at your feet.
It is much brighter here than in the egg.
I bury my head in your palm.
I look up and see you smile.
I still cannot fold my wings.
My red is still faint.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，喷出火星
lines.en: I sneeze, and sparks fly.
I choose you; that is settled.

lines.zh: 我靠着你的手睡了一会儿
lines.en: I slept a moment against your hand.
I am hungry, but first I look at you.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的翅膀，我乱扑
lines.en: Fire catches my wing; I flap wildly.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，摔得发懵
lines.en: I fall from height and lie dazed.

lines.zh: 水没到我的脖子，我拼命蹬
lines.en: Water reaches my neck; I kick desperately.
The blast throws me to your feet.
An arrow shaft hangs from my scales.

lines.zh: 那股力让我动不了，我叫起来
lines.en: That force freezes me, and I cry out.
Too hungry to cry anymore.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我钻进你怀里
lines.en: The thunder is too loud; I burrow against you.
No ground; I claw at nothing.
